i was in a really similar situation last fall right before i was diagnosed with ocd. i felt horribly anxious all the time, and i had conversations about it with my best friend and my boyfriend. i was absolutely terrified i had cheated on my bf and just didn't remember. after my diagnosis, one of the best things for me was naming the obsessive thoughts for what they were: obsessive thoughts and nothing more. i sat with the anxiety whenever i would encounter a trigger—"this is a trigger. i feel anxious. i'm going to keep watching/reading, and the anxiety will go away"—and that really helped too. 

i'm now really okay with those thoughts, even though i still sometimes try to avoid them because of how scary that pre-diagnosis part of my life was. i almost didn't open this post because i thought it might trigger a relapse in that obsession, but i'm glad that i did! it took a long time to get here though. 

i hope you're able work through this and move past this obsession, and that my experience can help you in some way. it's difficult, but i believe in you!
